title: Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana (RSBY) – legacy scheme Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Former Government of India health insurance scheme for below-poverty-line households and certain unorganised-sector workers; largely superseded by PM-JAY.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Historically targeted BPL families and specified unorganised-sector worker categories; not to be treated as a current enrolment route without official confirmation.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana (RSBY) – legacy scheme.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
